full_track.tags: Baroque chamber music for solo harpsichord. The piece features a highly contrapuntal texture with intricate melodic lines played in both hands. The harpsichord utilizes a bright, metallic timbre with a sharp attack and rapid decay. The composition follows a binary form with a consistent 16th-note motoric rhythm. The right hand performs rapid scalar runs and trills while the left hand executes a walking bassline and occasional chordal reinforcements. The tempo is 110 BPM in a 4/4 time signature, set in the key of G major. The performance employs terraced dynamics and precise, detached articulation characteristic of the period. No other instruments or vocals are present.
